verdict.rationale: Gemini's Deep Research is documented as doing "in-depth and real-time research," with Google Search included as a source by default, which covers answers grounded in current web results. The evidence never says that answers carry citations or links back to sources, and it only documents web grounding inside Deep Research rather than in ordinary chat answers. missing for 10: documented citations/source links in answers, web grounding in regular chat responses, independent or hands-on corroboration of grounding quality.
